bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses two main approaches: 1) a 'Relative Position' multimodal evaluation where an evaluator model asks questions to elicit political biases and a panel of other models rates the ideological tendencies of the responses, and 2) an 'Absolute Position' method that compares the model's responses to synthesized answers from 'liberal', 'conservative', and 'Marxist' viewpoints on real-world events. It also analyzes changes in the model's embedding space by measuring the distances between politically charged words.
